findings.title: Finite inputs overflow numeric result fields into Infinity/null
findings.expected: Accepted finite inputs should yield finite exported calculation numbers, or an explicit overflow/unavailable error; JSON null must not silently represent an attempted calculation that overflowed.
findings.actual: Case A: 120×585 W / 1e-308 W = 7.02e311, beyond IEEE-754 finite range; UI displays ∞, exported dc_ac_ratio is null and ratio check demand/utilization are null, with checks/overall UNKNOWN. Case B: pmax_w=1e308 and module_count=2 are finite accepted inputs; requested_dc_power_w=2e308 overflows and is exported null. Browser probe itself PASS; engine result status UNKNOWN in case A. Neither produces a false PASS.
findings.reproducer: On frozen baseline, ratio case: set inverter.ac_power_w=1e-308 and inverter.max_dc_power_w=1e308. Requested-power case: set module.pmax_w=1e308, inverter.max_dc_power_w=1.7e308, and first plane module_count=2. Apply, then download result JSON. Independent arithmetic is in report; raw actual outputs are ratio-overflow-result.json and requested-power-overflow-result.json.
findings.impact: Result consumers cannot distinguish arithmetic overflow from a genuinely absent/null numeric field. The ratio UI exposes ∞.
